# Mitanshu Goel

> Robotics & AI engineer in Delhi, India. Teleoperation rigs, synchronised capture, and the policies they train. B.Tech ECE (MAIT, 2022–2026), three robotics internships, open to Physical-AI and robotics roles.

## Projects
- [Dual-arm VR teleoperation](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/dual-arm-vr-teleop.html): Two Elite CS66 arms follow my hands live via Meta Quest 3; my real-time C++ loop servos at 125 Hz.
- [Teleop data → a π0.5 policy](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/franka-teleop-dataset.html): A 10-task LeRobot dataset teleoperated on an Elite CS66 and a Franka FR3, used to fine-tune a π0.5 policy.
- [Robot hand plays rock-paper-scissors](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/tesollo-rps.html): A 20-motor Tesollo DG-5F hand plays rock-paper-scissors; I built the vision layer.
- [Bodhi, the humanoid that answers](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/bodhi-humanoid.html): A Yanshee humanoid that sees with YOLOv8 and answers by voice.
- [Six legs, eighteen joints](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/hexapod.html): A team hexapod from the A.T.O.M. robotics lab at MAIT. I wrote the control node, the closed-form leg IK, and the Docker setup.
- [Bringing up a 6-DOF cobot](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/nextup-cobot.html): A supplied arm brought up in ROS 2 with MoveIt and KDL IK, from simulation to the real arm.
- [Bracing for a hit](https://mitanshu.dev/projects/brace-for-impact.html): An RL study in MuJoCo: warning a quadruped before a shove cuts falls 5× at 250 N; removing the warning leaves it 9× worse than never having one. The policies run live on the page. Code: https://github.com/mitanshu-2004/brace-for-impact
